memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'Sin waits at your door. You must rule over it.'

sequence.prompt: What happened with the two brothers? Put it in order.

items.label: Both brothers brought a gift to God
God was pleased with Abel's best gift
God warned Cain to rule over it

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Warned Cain before he went wrong

application.question: Wrong things start inside our hearts. Which one is hardest for you?
application.followUp: God warned Cain because He loved him — there was still time to turn back. When you feel it coming, stop and say: 'God, help me.' He will.
